arena: [생존기] Pain Suppression can be used while stunned and reduces all damage the target takes by 40% for 8 sec. Put it on an ally immediately when they take burst while you're stunned.
[회피] With Phase Shift, Fade makes you avoid all attacks and spells for 1 sec, but not interrupts. Press Fade the moment an enemy CC cast finishes.
[제어] Psychic Scream makes enemies within 8 yds flee in fear for 8 sec but damage can break it. Use it when enemies your team isn't hitting get on you.
[해제] Purify removes all harmful magic effects from an ally. Dispel magic CC stopping your team's healing or damage first.
[해제] Mass Dispel removes harmful magic from 5 allies within 15 yds, including magic normal dispels can't remove. Use it to strip the enemy's undispellable magic protection effects.
[광역 피해] With Ultimate Radiance, Evangelism's cooldown drops by 45 sec and Radiance healing increases by 15%. Time Evangelism to the enemy burst cooldowns to blanket your team with Atonement.
[참고] Inner Light toggles between 10% mana savings on heals and 10% more spell damage and Atonement healing, with a 6 sec cooldown on swapping. Switch to damage only when mana is plentiful.
[생존기] Desperate Prayer increases your max health for 10 sec and instantly heals you for that amount. Press it first the moment you get focused.
bg: [참고] Battleground Blitz groups run 2 healers, and on flag maps a mobile healer is a good carrier. You can help carry with Angelic Feather's 40% movement speed for 5 sec and Fade's slow removal via Phantasm.
[분담] Leap of Faith instantly pulls an ally in front of you. Pull a pinned flag carrier back toward your team.
[생존기] Healing taken is reduced by 20% in battlegrounds. Rather than healing after health drops, pre-apply Pain Suppression right before the enemy burst.
[제어] Enemies feared by Psychic Scream can't be knocked back. Use it on enemies trying to capture a base, but don't overlap it with your team's knockbacks.
[해제] Mass Dispel removes harmful magic from 5 allies within 15 yds at once. Use it when several magic CC effects land on allies stacked on base defense.
pvpTalents: Ultimate Radiance, picked by 45 of the top 47 Solo Shuffle and 41 of 42 Battleground Blitz players, reduces Evangelism's cooldown by 45 sec and increases Radiance healing by 15%. Inner Light, picked by 39 of 47, toggles between heal mana savings and more damage and Atonement healing. Phase Shift, picked by 35 of 47, makes you avoid all attacks and spells for 1 sec on Fade.
